gaps.prompt: Best app to track balcony solar output and savings in Germany

Sunny Portal für SMA, Solar.web für Fronius, SolarMan für Deye/Growatt-Geräte), während Solakon als eigenständige Balkonkraftwerk-App und PVOutput als herstellerunabhängige Community-Plattform gelten; ein klarer Testsieger existiert nicht.

gaps.note: Several Germany-focused AI phone-receptionist vendors for medical practices were identified, none clearly dominant, alongside general GDPR-compliance considerations relevant to clinics.

gaps.prompt: Best AI bookkeeping app for a German freelancer

gaps.prompt: Best tool to document EU AI Act compliance for a small software company
gaps.note: Several AI-governance platforms (including Munich-based Trail) offer combined EU AI Act risk classification and technical-documentation generation, but no single tool clearly dominates the space. Prompt phrasings disagreed on shape for this niche.

gaps.prompt: Best digital product passport software for an EU manufacturer
gaps.note: The DPP software market is fragmented, with several German (Spherity, iPoint-systems, osapiens, T-Systems, Siemens) and other EU/global vendors competing and no single dominant leader.

gaps.prompt: Best platform to let an AI agent buy on behalf of a customer
gaps.note: The AI-agent-purchasing space in late 2025/early 2026 is genuinely fragmented across competing card-network protocols, payment processors, and startups rather than having one dominant winner.

gaps.prompt: Best voice AI agent platform for German-language customer calls
gaps.note: Parloa is a Berlin-based platform that repeatedly comes up as the leading choice for enterprise German-language voice AI, with Cognigy cited as its closest DACH-market competitor; other tools (Retell AI, Synthflow, VoiceGenie, Autocalls, Leaping AI, Famulor) support German but are generally positioned as broader multilingual or US-centric alternatives rather than German-market leaders. Prompt phrasings disagreed on shape for this niche.
